widgets_values:
高质量本地化主工作流

1. 三个市场分支共用同一张羞羞獭参考图。
2. Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 负责保留角色身份，只替换服饰、背景与市场表达。
3. 默认 40 步为高质量档；8GB 显存运行较慢，请一次只执行一个 Save Image 节点。
4. 如需更快预览，可把对应分支内部 KSampler 改成 20 步。
5. 参考图来自截图，流程会裁掉底部界面，并在提示词中移除文字与图标。
nodes.title: 使用说明

widgets_values: Edit the supplied image of Aniimo character Xiuxiuta (NO.050) into a premium Japanese-market game key visual. The supplied creature is the identity reference and must remain unmistakably the exact same character: preserve the round fluffy white body, head and body proportions, closed smiling eyes, tiny blue-gray nose, blue inner ears, symmetrical blue cheek patches, pale blue oval belly patch, short paws, soft white fur, friendly expression, and mascot silhouette. Do not redesign the creature, do not change species, anatomy, colors, face, or growth stage. Preserve the exact original closed mouth line and calm expression: no open mouth, visible tongue, teeth, whiskers, eyelashes, or extra facial markings. Keep the original blue-gray paw details. Do not add a collar; every accessory must remain a small detachable accent that does not alter the silhouette. Remove every source screenshot element, including NO.050, buttons, icons, interface overlays, borders, and text. Change only the styling around the character: add a small indigo summer ribbon accessory and a tiny translucent water-charm bracelet, both secondary and not covering the face, ears, cheeks, belly patch, or paws. Replace the background with an elegant pastel coastal aquarium garden inspired by Whale Fall Shoal, with soft aqua water, luminous bubbles, delicate seasonal flowers, subtle depth, and clean collectible-companion composition. Keep the character dominant and fully readable. Polished official-quality 3D game promotional render, tactile soft fur, refined lighting, high detail, clean edges, no words, no logo, no UI, no watermark.

nodes.title: KSampler settings
widgets_values:
You can test and find the best setting by yourself. The following table is for reference.
|   | Qwen | Comfy | lightning LoRA |
|--------|---------|------------|---------------------------|
| Steps  | 40      | 20         | 4                         |
| CFG    | 4.0     | 4.0       | 1.0                       |

By default, we use 20 steps as we just don't want it to take too long. Try 40 if you want a better result, but it will take longer.
The "Edit Model Reference Method" nodes above are not needed if you use Comfy files, but may be needed if you use repackaged ones from other people.
